    Description
    CoastlineData
    A set of coastline polylines used by CoastlineShape, LandShape and the WorldMap land tint.
    CoastlineShape
    Bundled world coastlines that compose with other Canvas shapes and layers.
    GeoProjection
    Immutable equirectangular (plate carrée) projection of a MapViewport onto a terminal rectangle, correcting for the proportions of a terminal cell.
    LandShape
    Fills the bundled landmasses, giving a land/sea shading to pair with CoastlineShape.
    MapMarker
    An immutable geographic point rendered as a one-cell dot above coastlines, with an optional name drawn beside it.
    MapState
    Mutable view state for a map: the current MapViewport.
    MapViewport
    Immutable equirectangular bounds in degrees.
    RegionShape
    A filled and/or outlined geographic polygon (a region) that composes with other Canvas shapes and layers.
    RouteShape
    A geographic polyline (a route) that composes with other Canvas shapes and layers.
    WorldMap
    Stateless offline world map using bundled coastlines and Canvas Braille rendering.
    WorldMap.Builder
    Builder that snapshots configuration when building a widget.
